_comment: Smoke-feed scenarios as data. Times are scenario seconds from the start of the run. `at` is a world point name, a hold point id, `LANE@f` (fraction along the lane centerline), `FINAL_<rwy>@<nm>` (nm out on the extended final), or [lon, lat]. Each line is one push-to-talk utterance; `dur` is its length in seconds.
